info.name: Feature Flag Platform — Full Flow
info.description: Complete test collection covering every endpoint and scenario. Run folders in order: 01 → 02 → ... → 09. Variables are auto-captured via test scripts so you can run sequentially without manual copy-paste.

item.name: 01 — Auth
item.description: Register 3 users (Owner, Admin, Viewer) then login all of them. Tokens and userIds are auto-saved to collection variables.

item.name: 02 — Organizations
item.description: Full CRUD for organizations. Owner is auto-added as OWNER on creation.

item.name: 03 — Members
item.description: Invite Admin and Viewer users, list members, test permission restrictions, remove Viewer.

item.name: [ERR] Admin tries to invite another OWNER
04 — Projects
item.description: CRUD for projects under the organization.

item.name: [ERR] Duplicate project name in same org
05 — Environments
item.description: Create Production and Staging environments. API keys are auto-captured.

item.name: 06 — Feature Flags (Create)
item.description: Create 4 flags with different value types. States are auto-created for both Production and Staging.

item.name: [ERR] Create flag — duplicate key in project
07 — Feature Flags (Read & Update)
item.description: List, get, update flags and their states per environment.

item.name: 07-03 Update Flag (name/description only — key is immutable)
07-04 Get Flag State — Production (disabled by default)
07-08 Set payment-config JSON value on Production
[ERR] Viewer tries to update flag state
08 — SDK Evaluation
item.description: Simulate SDK client calls using X-Environment-Key header. No JWT required.

exec: pm.test('Staging has different value from Prod', () => pm.expect(checkout.value).to.eql('v3-beta'));

item.name: 08-03 SDK: Get specific flag by key
[ERR] SDK: JWT token on SDK endpoint (wrong auth)

exec: pm.test('Status 401 or 403 — JWT not accepted on SDK chain', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401,403]));

item.name: 09 — Archive & Cleanup
item.description: Archive a flag (soft delete), verify it disappears from SDK. Then clean up via hard deletes.

item.name: 09-02 SDK: Verify archived flag not in evaluation
09-03 SDK: Archived flag returns 404 by key

exec: pm.test('3 active flags visible in admin', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.lengthOf(3));
